title: Import all Markdown tasks through the MemorySmith MCP bridge
description:
Source: docs/tasks/tickets/CC-097-import-all-markdown-tasks-through-the-memorysmith-mcp-bridge.md
Source key: CC-097
Source status: Backlog
Source priority: P1

## Summary

Import all Markdown tasks through the MemorySmith MCP bridge

## User Mandate

> Now prepare for migrating and importing all of the tasks into the MS system programatically (though you can and should cleanup). We should try to use the actual MS import

STRICT: prepare and execute the migration through the actual MemorySmith service
when authenticated. Preserve the source task set and clean only normalization
issues that do not remove task history. Do not bypass service authorization or
store credentials in the repository.

## Scope

- Parse active and archived `docs/tasks/` Markdown tickets.
- Normalize CC status and priority values to the MemorySmith task contract.
- Preserve source keys, paths, tags, body headings, and original metadata.
- Create tasks through the live `memorysmith_task_create` MCP tool.
- Resume safely from `.service/memorysmith-import-state.json`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A dry-run accounts for every active and archived Markdown ticket.
- The live importer uses MemorySmith MCP task tools, not direct JSON writes.
- Re-running the importer does not duplicate records already recorded in state.
- Source CC keys remain searchable as labels and in task descriptions.
- Credentials remain outside tracked files.

## Validation

- Importer PowerShell parse check passes.
- Dry-run: 99 source tickets normalized, 0 created, 0 skipped.
- Live MCP read check: task store was empty before import.
- Live MCP write attempt: blocked with `The caller is not authorized to perform write operations.`
- Partial authenticated run: `CC-001` through `CC-006` exist in MemorySmith.
	`CC-006` was reconciled by title after the response decoder stopped before
	saving its state. The next unauthenticated call stopped at `CC-007`.

## Findings

- MemorySmith exposes no bulk-import MCP tool. The supported import path is a
	client loop over `memorysmith_task_create`, followed by status application when
	needed.
- MemorySmith allocates `TSK-####` keys. The original `CC-###` key is preserved
	as a label and in the description.
- `Review` maps to `Ready`, `In Progress` maps to `InProgress`, and archived
	`Superseded` maps to `Archived` with source labels.
- `CC-045` has no closing YAML fence. The importer falls back to its `## Summary`
	heading, matching the existing repository validator's accepted record shape.

## Blockers

- MCP read access works, but task creation requires an authenticated browser
	session. The browser login cookie is not available to the PowerShell process.
	Supply it only through `MEMORYSMITH_AUTH_COOKIE` for the live run, or complete
	the import from an authenticated MemorySmith bridge client.

## Next Step

Run the importer with an authenticated MemorySmith session cookie, then query
`memorysmith_task_list` and reconcile the returned count and source labels.

comments.body:
## User Mandate
> Ensure all CC legacy task files are captured within the MemorySmith TSK task system as appropriate (cross reference with the actual state) before we delete them (without removing from git history) to ensure we've cleanly switched over

STRICT. Every CC legacy ticket under docs/tasks/tickets/ and docs/tasks/archive/ must have a MemorySmith TSK owner that preserves its source key, content, and status before any working-tree deletion. Deletion must not remove the files from git history. Do not relax scope or drop CC content.

## Capture Reconciliation Evidence (2026-09-06)
- Enumerated 101 distinct CC ticket files (docs/tasks/tickets/ + docs/tasks/archive/): CC-001..CC-099 plus CC-056A and CC-056B.
- Cross-referenced every CC file against MemorySmith Data/Tasks/*.json records by source cc-### label and by "Source key: CC-###" description ownership.
- Result: CC-001..CC-098 (plus 056A/056B) each already own a dedicated TSK description. The sole unresolved gap, CC-099, was only a secondary label on TSK-0008 and lacked a dedicated record.
- Fix: created TSK-0119 "Harden fast SDF culling and non-finite field consumers" preserving CC-099 summary, scope, acceptance criteria, decision, findings, validation, and source labels (cc-099, source-cc, runtime, sdf, culling, non-finite, extraction, regression).
- Post-fix owner count: 101/101 CC keys are description owners of a TSK record. Test-TaskRecords.ps1: PASS, 119 records, ids/keys unique.
- Residual (non-blocking) migration artifact: CC-018 was imported three times (TSK-0018 InProgress owner; TSK-0019 and TSK-0020 Archived duplicates). Archived duplicates are harmless; noted for optional later cleanup.

## Next Step
Capture is complete and verified. Decommissioning (working-tree deletion of the frozen CC ticket files) is the remaining step and is gated on user confirmation of deletion scope and CI/tooling handling.
